text: Yeah, hi, so here's the problem. Like I said, I just moved from Florida to Phoenix. But my address is still the old one. Can you help me update that? And also, I wanna know what the cheapest t-shirt is right now. Can I get that through you?
zh: 是的，嗨，所以问题是。就像我说的，我刚从佛罗里达搬到凤凰城。但我的地址还是旧的。你能帮我更新吗？此外，我想知道现在最便宜的T恤是什么。我能通过你订购吗？
